text.description_html:
Deltana 8SSB32D, 8 Inch Stainless Steel Security Door Bolt

The Deltana 8" surface mounted door bolt is made of sturdy solid stainless steel. It is great for oudoor use, on doors that are located in harsh conditions, or any door requiring a high quality security door bolt. This is one of our most popular security bolts because of its strength and longevity.

Also available in other lengths:
6" Stainless Door Bolt - 10" Stainless Door Bolt - 12" Stainless Door Bolt

Packaged complete with mortise strike plate, angle strike plate, new guides and stainless steel mounting screws.

Specifications: of the Deltana 8SSB32D Security Door Bolt:

  • Bolt Length: 8"
  • Bolt Width: 3/4"
  • Bolt Thickness: 1/4"
  • Bolt Projection: 3/4"
  • Max Projection at Knob: 1-3/8"
  • Bolt Throw: 1-1/4"
  • Guide Plate Width: 2"
  • Mortise Strike Length: 3"
  • Mortise Strike Width: 3/4"
  • Angle Strike Length: 2"
  • Angle Strike Width: 3/4"
  • Material: Solid 304 Stainless Steel
  • Brushed Stainless Steel Finish
  • Deltana 8SSB32D Dimensions (PDF)
